english: 60-63. In the middle of the forest, he thought thus: ‘Alas! What a fool had I been! Urvaśī has not been obtained by me. Of what avail is this Agnisthālī for me?’ Then the king dropped the Agnisthālī in the forest and went to his own city. When the midnight was past he woke up from his sleep and thought thus: ‘It is for the purpose of achieving the world of Urvaśī that the Agnisthālī was given to me by the eminent Gandharvas. But it has been dropped in the forest by me. I shall get it back.’ Thinking thus, he got up and went to the forest. But Purūravas was not able to see the Agnisthālī there.
